verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen freely spin on you under tower-range pressure before level 6; you win if you survive to Titanic Hydra and out-scale his flat damage with Vorpal Blade poke and split-push threat.

brief.thesis: Garen has no mana bar, so his W (Courage) and E (Judgment) come out on cooldown alone, meaning his aggression is relentless and punished only by dodging or shielding, not by resource denial. Shen's W (Feint) absorbing a hit is the single tool that converts a losing trade into an even one, which is exactly why OP.GG flags using the shield to eat his Q (Decisive Strike) auto. The measured 49% win rate over 1994 games and Garen's solo-kill edge confirm this is a lane you survive, not one you contest for kills.

theirWindow.when: E (Judgment) and Q (Decisive Strike) both up
theirWindow.what: He can silence your Q with his empowered auto then follow with a full E spin for a big burst window; back off to minion range or hold W (Feint) to absorb the spin damage.

yourWindow.what: Step in and land Q (Vorpal Blade) for the life-tap heal; at level 6+ this is also your window to threaten E (Shadow Dash) taunt-engage since he has no spin to punish the dash-in.

start.why: 49.1% win rate over 1585 games as the most-picked start; the regen and physical-damage block directly blunt his auto-attack and W (Courage) poke while his passive Perseverance tries to out-sustain you.

boots.why: 48.9% win rate at 79.2% pick; the attack-speed reduction cuts into his auto-reliant W (Courage) and basic attack damage, which is most of his lane pressure.

core.why: Core first item in every top build path; the stacking auto-damage and AoE cleave let you fight through his sustain and punish him for standing in minion waves.
Follows Titanic Hydra in all three listed build paths; adds the mixed stats Shen needs to keep pace once Garen hits his mid-game damage spike.
56.1% win rate over 123 games as the third item; grievous wounds and bonus armor directly counter his Perseverance healing and physical burst.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the passive trade pattern this lane demands: poke with Q (Vorpal Blade) on cooldown into minion contact and walk away, stacking health and sustain rather than matching his W (Courage) extended-fight damage.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport sits at 47.1% win rate and 29.4% pick, the second-most-run pairing; Shen's split-push identity and global R (Stand United) threat make Teleport's lane reset and side-lane flexibility worth more here than Ignite's early kill pressure, since this matchup is about scaling, not early kills.

playing.title: Trade only through minions
playing.detail: Land Q (Vorpal Blade) when a minion is between you and Garen so the life-tap heal offsets his auto-attack and W (Courage) damage; never stand in open lane range where he can freely spin.

playing.title: Save W for his silence-auto
playing.detail: W (Feint) up to 9-5s cooldown should be held to absorb the empowered auto-attack after his Q (Decisive Strike) fires, since that single hit plus the silence is his biggest single-trade spike.

playing.title: Hold E until he commits
playing.detail: E (Shadow Dash) at 16-8s cooldown taunts on contact, so dash in only when he's already extended past minion range or when you need to lock him for a jungler gank, not as a poke tool.

playing.title: Track his R at level 6+
playing.detail: Demacian Justice (140-20s cooldown) threatens an execute the moment you drop below half health; play around having W (Feint) available whenever you're under 50% HP near him.

playing.title: Don't contest extended fights
playing.detail: His passive Perseverance and W (Courage) win anything past a 3-second trade; disengage after your Q-W-E combo lands rather than standing to auto-trade.

playing.title: Prioritize split-push from level 9
playing.detail: Once Titanic Hydra is online, your side-lane pressure and R (Stand United) teleport threat matter more than winning the 1v1, since the raw matchup sits at 49% and solo-kill favors him.

playing.title: Use R to swing fights, not save duels
playing.detail: Stand United's 160-200s cooldown is too long to waste on contesting a lost 1v1; save it to shield and teleport to a teammate winning elsewhere.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and trade patterns are this brief's own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.
